title: Range of entries in a zipped list
statement: Let $p$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $f(a,b)<p$ for all natural numbers $a,b$. For any two finite lists of natural numbers, every entry of the list formed by applying $f$ pairwise to their entries up to the length of the shorter list is strictly less than $p$.
